1-33-37. Bureau of Information and Technology created.

There is hereby created within the Department of Executive Management the Bureau of Information and Technology.

Source: SL 1994, ch 412 (Ex. Ord. 94-4), § 17; SL 2003, ch 272 (Ex. Ord. 03-1), § 82; SL 2026, ch 1 (Ex. Ord. 26-2), § 17, eff. Apr. 13, 2026.
